## Subtopics Visible in the Publication Data

Based on the article synopses, rationales, and impact justifications retrieved, WCM faculty publishing on aging cluster around at least **six distinct subtopics**:

### 1. 🔴 Elder Mistreatment & Abuse
Screening, intervention, survivor perspectives, caregiver neglect, and hospital-based response programs. This is the most densely represented cluster in the current retrieval, with faculty across Geriatrics, Emergency Medicine, and Psychiatry publishing actively through 2025. Representative work includes [caregiver neglect screening frameworks](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39693260/) and [ED-based mistreatment response programs](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39775663/).

### 2. 🟠 Frailty, Chronic Pain & Multimorbidity
Links between persistent pain, frailty, cognitive decline, and functional status in older adults. Includes psychotherapeutic interventions (e.g., PATH-Pain RCT) and ecological momentary assessment methods. Representative work: [pain–frailty linkage](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31343692/) and [PATH-Pain trial](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39875212/).

### 3. 🟡 Aging with HIV / Infectious Disease & Aging
Geriatric syndromes, epigenetic aging clocks, frailty biomarkers (cell-free mitochondrial DNA), and inflammation in older people living with HIV. Spans Infectious Diseases and Endocrinology. Representative work: [epigenetic sex differences in HIV aging](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39923742/) and [metformin epigenetic age reversal](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37675817/).

### 4. 🟢 Social Isolation, Loneliness & Technology Interventions
RCT-based work on social connectedness, loneliness, depression, and technology platforms (PRISM trials) to support aging adults. Representative work: [PRISM loneliness RCT](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34675843/) and [PRISM 2.0 trial](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38854853/).

### 5. 🔵 Geriatric Cardiology & Cardiovascular Aging
Frailty assessment in heart failure (HFpEF), fall-risk prescribing, and geriatric vulnerabilities in cardiovascular disease. Representative work: [geriatric cardiology framework](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37705890/) and [frailty in HFpEF](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40155186/).

### 6. 🟣 Cellular & Molecular Biology of Aging
Senolytic treatments, epigenetic clocks (retroelement-based), nucleolar aging mechanisms, and age-modulating compounds in model systems. Representative work: [Retro-age epigenetic biomarker](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39092674/) and [nucleolar mortality timer](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39587368/).
